title: Digitalis fhir-hub Implementation Guide
introduction: FHIR R4 conformance artifacts for the Digitalis FHIR interface: two contracts on two FHIR bases — Prescriptor, the prescribing sessions of $formulary-session, $createrx-session and $session-result, and Surveillance, whose $check-medication request contract is published but not yet implemented.

list.desc: Adds the medication-surveillance contract on a second FHIR base: $check-medication, its request profile and its example. The operation itself is not implemented and answers 501. Nothing on the EVS contract changed.
First release. The three operations, 13 profiles, 2 extensions, 1 code system and 9 value sets.
